mapper.sql: id, user_id, receiver_name, receiver_phone, province, city, district, detail_address, postal_code, is_default, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM addresses WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT FROM addresses WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_default = 1 ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO addresses (user_id, receiver_name, receiver_phone, province, city, district, detail_address, postal_code, is_default, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{province}, #{city}, #{district}, #{detailAddress}, #{postalCode}, #{isDefault}, NOW(6), NOW(6))
mapper.update: UPDATE addresses SET user_id = #{userId}, receiver_name = #{receiverName}, receiver_phone = #{receiverPhone}, province = #{province}, city = #{city}, district = #{district}, detail_address = #{detailAddress}, postal_code = #{postalCode}, is_default = #{isDefault}, updated_at = NOW(6) WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE addresses SET is_default = 0 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_default = 1
AND id <> #{exceptId}
